data.one_liner: Backdrop widget that overlays a front layer over a back layer with animated reveal/conceal.
data.what_it_does: Provides a BackdropScaffold that lets you define a backLayer and a frontLayer. The front layer can be toggled to show or hide the back layer with smooth animation. It also offers navigation helpers and state access via Backdrop.of.
use_when: You need a Material Design backdrop effect for a screen
You want a single widget that manages front/back layers and their animation
You prefer a declarative API without manual animation controllers
avoid_when: You need fine‑grained control over the animation timing
You are building a highly custom layered UI that doesn't fit the backdrop pattern

alternatives.name: flutter_staggered_grid_view
alternatives.why_pick_it: For complex grid layouts instead of a backdrop

data.minimal_example:
BackdropScaffold(
  appBar: BackdropAppBar(title: Text("Backdrop")),
  backLayer: Center(child: Text("Back Layer")),
  frontLayer: Center(child: Text("Front Layer")),
)
